Marissa / team / Alex —

Quick answers and attachments below for the questionnaire items we can share immediately.

SOC 2: 
- Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for the period ending 2025-11-30.
- Attached: SOC2_AOC_2025.pdf (available for review). For full report access we normally share the AOC and, after a minimal NDA, provide the full report or a redacted executive summary.

HIPAA / BAA: 
- Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads and will execute a BAA with customers processing PHI. Our platform offers encryption at rest and in transit, role-based access controls, and audit logs suitable for BAAs. Dev, tagging for legal: can you confirm our standard BAA doc link?

Pen Test / Vulnerability Management: 
- Most recent third-party penetration test: 2026-04-20 (performed by AegisSec). We can provide a redacted summary that includes scope, key findings, and mitigation status. Full report requires NDA; we typically turn that around within 2 business days of an executed NDA and identity verification.
- Vulnerability SLA (typical):
  * Critical: initial triage within 24 hours, remediation/mitigation plan within 72 hours
  * High: initial triage within 48 hours, remediation within 7 calendar days
  * Medium: remediation within 30 days
  * Low: remediation within 90 days or scheduled for next maintenance window
- Scanning cadence: internal CI/CD SAST/DAST scans weekly; dependency scanning on each build; external vulnerability scan monthly; third-party pen test annually (or on major releases).
- Disclosure: we follow coordinated disclosure. For critical issues we notify affected customers and provide mitigations as soon as available; we maintain a public security@redwood.ai contact for reporting.

Attachments included: SOC2_AOC_2025.pdf, PenTest_Summary_Redacted.pdf

If FinHealth would like the full pen test report, we’ll share our standard NDA (DocuSign link below) and then provide the full PDF within ~2 business days once signed.

DocuSign NDA (standard): https://docusign.com/FinHealth-NDA/12345
